President Donald Trump's attorneys leave U.S. District Court in Miami on July 21, 2026, following a hearing in his defamation suit against the BBC. A federal judge in Florida has given President Donald Trump a temporary reprieve from an order that he share details of his businesses’ financial performance with the BBC in connection with a libel suit Trump filed against the network. U.S. District Judge Roy Altman said he was putting that discovery order on hold while he decides on a motion by Trump to reframe and, in some respects, narrow his claims against the British Broadcasting Corporation in connection with a 2024 documentary
results.title: Judge pauses order sending Trump financial data to BBC - Politico
